tree: 1. Ceiba speciosa / Chorisia insignis 'falso kapok', Orto Botanico di Napoli (40.86120, 14.26219)
notes: Viewed the pixels. Daylight colour portrait of a colossal multi-stemmed Ceiba: four pale green-grey trunks rising from one swollen buttressed base that fills the lower half of the frame, blue sky and dappled light behind, botanical-garden lawn with a small green plant label at the foot and pink Ceiba petals fallen on the grass, a Dracaena draco and palms in the background left. Trunk unmistakably the subject and centred, so it survives a wide card crop; crown foliage reads at the top of the frame though the full canopy is cut off, which is normal for a tree this size photographed from beneath. Proof it is this tree: the observation carries GPS 40.86119014, 14.26211407 with 6 m positional accuracy, seven metres from the register coordinate for the Orto Botanico falso kapok, and the surroundings (labelled specimens, dragon tree, palm collection) are the Orto Botanico.
